about: A screenplay line typed `scene_heading`, which is not in §1.3.1's closed set. A reader must keep it as unknown content and must not read it as a heading, so story order would silently lose a scene; an error, because two readers that disagree here disagree about the story.

findings.message: Line 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 has line_type "scene_heading", which is not in the published set; it is unknown content and maps to nothing.
findings.title: Screenplay line has a line_type outside the published set
